bundle.shortDescription: Six-degree-of-freedom flight dynamics and telemetry workspace
bundle.longDescription: HexaDOF simulates, observes, records, replays, and compares the six-degree-of-freedom motion of a rocket or other rigid aerospace body. It is an analysis and instrumentation tool, and its results do not certify flight safety.
